cases.meaning: The SDK obtains the policy projection and evaluates weak and compliant passwords without sending plaintext to fireemu-specific endpoints.
cases.configuration: Explicit local passwordPolicy only; no configuration mutation.
cases.principal: client SDK API key for the selected local project
cases.setup: Initialize a fresh Firebase Auth instance and connectAuthEmulator.
cases.observation: validatePassword() twice; record only lengths, booleans, and policy projection.
cases.postStateReadback: No account or credential mutation is expected.
cases.cleanup: signOut and close the local fireemu process through fireemu exec.
cases.comparator: Typed SDK result and policy projection comparator v1; production remains unobserved.
cases.localControl: The runner refuses missing or non-fireemu artifact binding and loopback violations.
cases.productionOnlyReason: SDK projection, backend enforcement, and SDK cache semantics require a fixed production API/SDK observation; local success cannot establish parity.

cases.meaning: A tenant-selected Auth instance is kept separate from project scope; configuration-change comparisons distinguish same-instance cache from a fresh instance.
cases.configuration: Dedicated tenant policy only when an owner-approved tenant exists; no implicit tenant creation or inheritance.
cases.principal: client SDK API key plus explicit tenantId
cases.setup: Run project and tenant reads in separate Auth instances.
cases.observation: Compare policy projections and validation statuses; do not treat undefined fields as false.
cases.postStateReadback: No user, token, OOB, or policy mutation.
cases.cleanup: Dispose local instances with the parent fireemu process.
cases.localControl: The candidate must fail closed if tenant binding or artifact binding is absent.
cases.productionOnlyReason: Project-to-tenant inheritance and cache invalidation are not established by local SDK execution.
